--  DDL for Function F_ULTIMO_DIA
--------------------------------------------------------

  CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "HELEN"."F_ULTIMO_DIA" (ve_mes NUMBER, ve_ano NUMBER)
RETURN number
AS
BEGIN
   DECLARE
      vl_fecha_ultimo_dia DATE;
   BEGIN
      vl_fecha_ultimo_dia := To_Date('01/' || To_Char(ve_mes, '00') || '/' || To_Char(ve_ano, '0000'), 'dd/mm/yyyy');
      vl_fecha_ultimo_dia := vl_fecha_ultimo_dia + 31;
      vl_fecha_ultimo_dia := vl_fecha_ultimo_dia - To_Number(To_Char(vl_fecha_ultimo_dia, 'dd'));
      RETURN To_Number(To_Char(vl_fecha_ultimo_dia, 'dd'));
   END;
END;
  GRANT EXECUTE ON "HELEN"."F_ULTIMO_DIA" TO "HELEN_FULL"
  GRANT DEBUG ON "HELEN"."F_ULTIMO_DIA" TO "HELEN_FULL"
  GRANT EXECUTE ON "HELEN"."F_ULTIMO_DIA" TO "SELECT_ALL_HELEN"
--------------------------------------------------------
--  DDL for Function F_ULTIMO_PAGO
--------------------------------------------------------

  CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "HELEN"."F_ULTIMO_PAGO" (ve_cod_deudor number)
RETURN number
AS
/******************************************************************************
   NAME:
   PURPOSE:

   REVISIONS:
   Ver        Date        Author           Description
	1.0		10/12/10		IS				retorna la cantidad de sub_boletas de un plan_pago
   ---------  ----------  ---------------  ------------------------------------


   NOTES:
******************************************************************************/
BEGIN
	DECLARE vl_cod_wp_transaccion        NUMBER;

	BEGIN

	SELECT WP.COD_WP_TRANSACCION
	INTO vl_cod_wp_transaccion
		FROM WP_TRANSACCION WP, DEUDOR DR
        WHERE TIPO_PAGO_WEB = 'PAGO_SEGIC'
        AND WP.COD_DEUDOR = DR.COD_DEUDOR
        AND WP.COD_DEUDOR =ve_cod_deudor
        AND EXITO IS NULL
        AND TOKEN IS NOT NULL
        AND ROWNUM = 1
        ORDER BY COD_WP_TRANSACCION DESC;



	return vl_cod_wp_transaccion;

  END;
END;

--  DDL for Function F_VALIDA_MONEDA
--------------------------------------------------------

  CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "HELEN"."F_VALIDA_MONEDA" 
return VARCHAR2
is
BEGIN
	DECLARE
    		vl_current_date VARCHAR2(10) := to_char(sysdate, 'dd/mm/yyyy');
    		ve_cod_moneda NUMBER;
    		vl_string  VARCHAR2(1000);
    		vl_count NUMBER;
    		ve_simbolo VARCHAR2(10);
    		vl_tiene_moneda NUMBER := 0;


	BEGIN
  	select	count(*) INTO vl_count 
	from	VALOR_MONEDA where cod_moneda <> 1
	AND		To_Char(FECHA_VALOR_MONEDA,'dd/mm/yyyy') = vl_current_date;

		IF(vl_count > 0) then
			vl_string := '0';

		ELSE
		  	vl_string := 'Señor Usuario: El valor moneda del presente mes, no esta ingresado.\nIngrese valor moneda por favor para: ';
		END IF;	

	DECLARE CURSOR C_MONEDA  is
	select cod_moneda, simbolo from moneda where cod_moneda <> 1;

	BEGIN
	open C_MONEDA; 
    LOOP

	FETCH C_MONEDA INTO ve_cod_moneda,ve_simbolo;
 	EXIT WHEN C_MONEDA%NOTFOUND;

	SELECT	count(*) INTO vl_count
	from	VALOR_MONEDA 
	where	COD_MONEDA = ve_cod_moneda 
	AND		To_Char(FECHA_VALOR_MONEDA,'dd/mm/yyyy')  = vl_current_date;

	END LOOP;

	CLOSE C_MONEDA;
	END;

	    if(vl_count = 0)THEN
        vl_tiene_moneda := 1;
		    vl_string := vl_string || ve_simbolo ||', ';
	    END IF;	



		if(vl_tiene_moneda = 1)THEN
			vl_string := vl_string || SUBSTR(', ',0,0);
		END IF;

	return 	vl_string;

  END;
END;
--------------------------------------------------------
--  DDL for Function SPLIT
--------------------------------------------------------

  CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "HELEN"."SPLIT" 
(
    p_list varchar2,
    p_del varchar2 := ','
) return split_tbl pipelined
/*
modo de uso:
SELECT * FROM TABLE(f_split('a|b', '|'));
SELECT column_value FROM TABLE(f_split('a|b', '|'));
*/
is
    l_idx    pls_integer;
    l_list    varchar2(32767) := p_list;
    l_value    varchar2(32767);
begin
    loop
        l_idx := instr(l_list,p_del);
        if l_idx > 0 then
            pipe row(substr(l_list,1,l_idx-1));
            l_list := substr(l_list,l_idx+length(p_del));

        else
            pipe row(l_list);
            exit;
        end if;
    end loop;
    return;
end split;
  GRANT EXECUTE ON "HELEN"."SPLIT" TO "HELEN_FULL"
  GRANT DEBUG ON "HELEN"."SPLIT" TO "HELEN_FULL"
  GRANT EXECUTE ON "HELEN"."SPLIT" TO "SELECT_ALL_HELEN"
